context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 216af Brand Inheritance features verified: (1) GET /api/sites/{id}/branding returns 200 with {site_id, site_name, effective: {name, logo_url, primary_color, secondary_color, _inherits, _parent}, override, parent}. (2) PATCH /api/sites/{id}/branding accepts subset of fields, empty string clears override. (3) _inherits flags correctly flip between true/false based on override state. (4) GET /api/m/{slug}/branding with ?site= returns site branding when override exists (branding_source='site'), org branding otherwise (branding_source='organization'). (5) PATCH /api/organization/branding regression passes. (6) Frontend SiteBrandingOverride component has all required data-testid attributes. (7) PulseSettingsTab has Branding button with toggle-site-branding-{id} testid. (8) SiteModulesOverride still exists (regression). NOTE: UI login flow has known redirect issue - use token injection for UI testing.
